head: 88daf81bb0f613faf61ac46ecbabcc8112993af1
purpose: Select the next prompt-general validation entry after native sparse/dataflow routes failed hard bounds. This is not SOTA and not a source change.
task_context: Need stable >5 tok/s for random/generalized prompts on 16GB host RAM including page cache + 32GB RTX 5090. No prompt-specific optimization. Held-out test set remains locked until candidate freeze.

native_fp4_fp8_gguf.status: current no-prompt-specific generalized baseline 1.8-2.7 tok/s; France-specialized 4.4 invalid for generalized target

cloudyu_4expert.status: local but correctness failed in prior France smoke; not a performance candidate until correctness root-caused

tarruda_q2k_header_shard.status: metadata/header shard only; first shard has no tensors; not runnable

selected_candidate.why_selected: Smallest single-file prompt-general GGUF candidate seen in current metadata, small enough to fit available disk. It may reduce cold page-cache/file pressure without prompt-specific packs, but correctness/load are unknown.

rejected_or_deferred_candidates.reason: already local but correctness failed; do not benchmark token-rate until correctness is fixed
split/header complexity; existing first shard metadata-only; requires multi-shard loader validation before full download
closed by sparse-pair generalized bound audit; zero-overhead top512 min only about 2.074 tok/s

validation_plan.stage_1_download: Download to an isolated model directory with resumable tool; do not delete protected accepted SOTA assets; verify size and sha256/etag if practical.
validation_plan.stage_2_header_load_smoke: Run a strict 16GB/no-swap n=1 or minimal load smoke using vendor llama-cli, no prompt-specific env, stdout controlled; record tensor metadata/load errors.
validation_plan.stage_3_france_correctness_smoke: Only if load passes, run France calibration semantic check under MemoryMax=16000000000 including page cache; not SOTA.
validation_plan.stage_4_calibration_dev: Only if France correctness passes, run calibration_dev_set_v1 no-prompt-specific metrics. Candidate must improve min/mean and stay RAM/TTFT compliant before freeze.
validation_plan.stage_5_held_out: Only after candidate freeze, run held_out_test_set_v1_locked once and claim generalized result only from held-out metrics.

decision.next_action: Write this plan into the main plan and push. Then, if continuing this route, start the IQ2_S download as a validation candidate, not as SOTA.
decision.risk: Large 88GB download may leave limited disk headroom; correctness may fail like other low-bit/4Expert candidates. Stop immediately on load/correctness failure.
